Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs)
What they do:
Tiny sensors inserted under the skin track interstitial glucose levels every few minutes.
Leading brands:
Abbott FreeStyle Libre, Dexcom, and Medtronic.
Cost context:
In India, monthly out-of-pocket costs typically range from ₹5,000 for flash systems up to ₹30,000 for real-time continuous setups.

Smartwatches & Wearable ECG
What they do:
Optical (PPG) sensors gauge heart rate and blood oxygen (SpO₂), while electrical sensors capture single-lead ECGs to flag potential arrhythmias.
MDPI
Common options:
Devices from Apple, Samsung, Fitbit, or consumer wellness smartwatches feature built-in or companion app vital tracking.
Sleep Trackers & Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)
What they do:
Use accelerometers and heart rate variability (HRV) to analyze sleep stages, or transmit home vital data (blood pressure, glucose, ECG) to clinical care teams.

Clinical RPM:
Allows doctors to supervise chronic conditions like diabetes or hypertension remotely via connected cellular or Bluetooth gateways.
